'''L·O·V·E·L·Y ~Dreaming LOVELY BOY~''' (Japanese: '''{{ruby|L|エル}}・{{ruby|O|オー}}・{{ruby|V|ヴィー}}・{{ruby|E|イー}}・{{ruby|L|エル}}・{{ruby|Y|ワイ}} ～{{ruby|夢見|ゆめみ}}る{{ruby|LOVELY BOY|ラヴリーボーイ}}～''' ''L·O·V·E·L·Y ~Yumemiru LOVELY BOY~'') is the Japanese ending theme for ''[[M07|Sky-Splitting Visitor: Deoxys]]''. A version subtitled "A Version with Pikachu★!", which features {{p|Pikachu}}, {{p|Plusle}}, and {{p|Minun}} singing along with the music, was also included on the song's single release.

An instrumental version, subtitled "{{Ash}}, [[Tory Lund|Tory]] - the Beginning of Friendship", was also used in [[Sky-Splitting Visitor: Deoxys Music Collection|the movie's score]]. The song's melody is also present in two other pieces, "Successful Rescue" and "That's a Mysterious Friend..."
